findings.claim: PRD 15.3 OpenCode 2 column uses v1 hook names (session.created, chat.message, tool.execute.before, tool.execute.after); v2 has none of these as hooks.
findings.evidence: opencode@1438073 packages/plugin/src/promise/session.ts:138-151 SessionHooks = prompt, context, compaction, ...; promise/tool.ts:38-64 ToolHooks = execute.before, execute.after registered via ctx.tool.hook(name). session.created exists only as a bus event (core/src/plugin/plan.ts:75-78 ctx.event.subscribe). No chat.message in core/plugin src. tickets/spike-hooks-verified.md:47 'v1 names are absent from v2 core'. README:71 already says use the context hook.
findings.fix: Replace column with: SessionStart = session hook `context` (once-per-session guard) + `compaction`; UserPromptSubmit = session hook `prompt`; PreToolUse = tool hook `execute.before`; PostToolUse = tool hook `execute.after`.

findings.claim: 'Keep "context-mode" in .plugin[] if v2 uses the same id' is wrong: the v1 entry is an npm package spec, not an id. Kept, OpenCode 2 installs v1 from npm and fails to load it next to the v2 git entry.
findings.evidence: cm-main src/adapters/opencode/index.ts:502-505 pushes bare 'context-mode' into settings.plugin. opencode core/src/config/normalize.ts:185-190 merges legacy `plugin` and `plugins` into one list; core/src/plugin/module.ts:104-109 npm.add(target) for any non-absolute target; v1 default export {id, server} (cm-main plugin.ts:757) fails the v2 Module schema (module.ts:78-91 needs effect or setup) = issue #1199. ARCHAEOLOGY: INTRODUCED_BY 75ae6ae3 2026-03-05 'feat: multi-platform adapters, session continuity, hook scripts' (git blame index.ts:502-506). ORIGINAL_INTENT: '// Add "context-mode" to the plugin array'. REGRESSION_RISK: double load, npm fetch of frozen v1. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: remove only the exact string 'context-mode' (and 'context-mode@*') from plugin[]; keep user entries.
findings.fix: Rule: remove the bare 'context-mode' npm spec from `plugin`/`plugins` and add the git+…#release entry; report, not keep.

findings.claim: ADR-0010 puts OpenCode 2 in 'git checkout' mode (ctx_upgrade fetches the release commit into its own version dir), but ADR-0011:44 installs OpenCode 2 as a `git+https://…#release` plugin spec, which OpenCode itself installs and re-checks. Two owners of the same install.
findings.evidence: opencode packages/util/src/npm.ts:59-71 git target, mutable when not a commit; :368 and :394 mutable targets re-resolved/added by host. tickets/spike-distribution-verified.md:13 'Git spec: 24h check that compares commit revisions'. ADR-0011:44 OpenCode 2 = git+https spec.
findings.fix: Pick one per agent in adapters/table.ts: OpenCode 2 = host-managed (ctx_upgrade prints the refresh step), or absolute-path checkout (then ADR-0011:44 changes). No both.

findings.claim: Docs do not decide whether OpenCode 2 gets ctx tools from the MCP server (name context-mode_ctx_execute, codemode, server instructions) or registers them in-process via ctx.tool.transform (PRD:242 'in-process plugin glue'; ADR-0016:40 'in-process'). Tool names, instructions delivery (ADR-0004) and the hint path differ.
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC:76,172,190 assume MCP; PRD-v2.md:242 opencode.ts 'in-process plugin glue → same core calls'; spike-distribution-verified.md:13 'MCP added separately'. opencode core/src/tool/mcp.ts:16-17,45 namespace only for MCP tools; plugin tools come through promise/tool.ts:26-36 ToolEditor.namespace/add.
findings.fix: State one path for OpenCode 2 in the adapter table: MCP server + plugin hooks only, or plugin-registered tools only; derive tool-name map and instructions channel from it.

findings.claim: Subagent detection is specified only for Claude Code (agent_type, .claude/agents/*.md). For OpenCode 2 the ADR says 'yes' to cases A-C but gives no way to know a call is inside a subagent or which tools it has.
findings.evidence: OpenCode payload: promise/tool.ts:39-46 execute.before has sessionID, agent (Agent.ID), no agent_type; subagent sessions carry parentID (schema/src/session.ts:33); subagent tool set comes from agent permissions (core/src/tool/plugin/subagent.ts:286-292 Permission.evaluate). ADR-0016:40 row only.
findings.fix: Add OpenCode 2 rule: subagent = session with parentID (ctx.session.get); tool set = Permission.evaluate over ctx_* for event.agent; golden case per A/B/C.

findings.claim: Codemode hook firing on OpenCode 2 is left [U]/G25, but source answers it: inner codemode calls go through beforeExecute and executeTool, so execute.before/after fire with the inner tool name.
findings.evidence: opencode packages/core/src/tool.ts:239-243 CodeModeTool.create(..., (name, tool, input, context) => beforeExecute(name, input, context).pipe(Effect.flatMap((event) => executeTool(tool, name, event.input, context)))); executeTool triggers execute.after (tool.ts:131-149).
findings.fix: Mark OpenCode 2 part of G25 [V] source; keep one live check in GP-LIVE.
